purpose: Authoritative, metadata-only specification of the unified PneumaBrain-v0 training corpus: the terminal role of every dataset lane, the v0.1 training members with their remaining gates, the quarantined cross-dataset overlap repos, the split policy, and the single human authorization gate. This manifest authorizes no training and grants no training weight; it makes the readiness state machine-checkable via python -m pneuma_lab.dataset_readiness --check.

role_definitions.v0_1_train: Member of the first unified training corpus; carries real agent attempts with a distributed pass/fail outcome. Still zero training weight until the corpus authorization is signed.
role_definitions.expansion_train_later: Genuine training candidate deferred to a later version; needs adapter, join, license, or quarantine work before it can join the corpus.
role_definitions.eval_only: Held-out evaluation or calibration set; never a training source (training on it would contaminate evaluation).
role_definitions.blocked: Excluded until a hard license, privacy, or dual-use gate clears.

remaining_gates: signed corpus authorization manifest (decision=authorized) with source/split/code bindings
reproducible full-corpus conversion artifacts under build/
full-corpus repo-grouped split generated and reviewed
explicit resolution or sign-off on the Minimax/Qwen output-ToS caveat
overlapping repos quarantined to a single split (see quarantine)

minimum_viable_corpus.note: Dataset #1 is the only lane with validated trajectory+outcome, splits, and leakage controls today, so it can form a minimum viable v0.1 corpus on its own once authorized. open-swe-traces joins as soon as its member gates clear.

quarantine.reason: repo-level train/test leakage between the two v0_1_train lanes
quarantine.policy: each overlapping repo must be assigned to a single split across all member lanes, or held out entirely

split_policy.note: No repository may appear in both train and eval across member lanes; all variants, candidates, and trajectories for one instance stay together. Mirrors the estimator split method sha256_repo_mod10_lt3_eval_v1.

mixture_caps.note: OpenHands-Sampled is imbalanced (few resolved vs many unresolved); the trainer must class-balance and cap any single family per optimization window.

eval_only_lanes.reason: canonical held-out benchmark; training would contaminate evaluation, plus solution-leakage and weak-oracle label issues
anti-contamination dynamic benchmark; held-out evaluation and calibration only

blocked_lanes.reason: unspecified HF artifact license; held-out role
archived; undeclared artifact license; superseded by open-swe-traces

requires: overlapping repos quarantined per the quarantine policy
explicit human decision=authorized with corpus_manifest_sha256, per-member source/split hashes, and authorized_code_commit
clean, authorized code state at run time
